tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Mike Reams's posts, work items, diagrams and agent skills by keyword. Returns titles, one-line summaries and canonical URLs, best match first.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'CSDM application service' or 'AI governance'

type.description: Limit to one kind of page

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read one public page (a post, work item, diagram, skill, /about or /toolbox) as Markdown, with its canonical URL. Pass a path such as /writing/<slug> or a full mikereams.com URL.

path.description: Path or https://mikereams.com URL of the page

tools.name: list_diagrams
tools.description: List the reference diagrams, including the CSDM models drawn in Blueprint Modeler, with each one's summary, page, downloadable model file and Open-in-Blueprint-Modeler link where there is one.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the skills in the AI Library, filtered by origin, category or keyword. An original (written by Mike) comes with its install command; a curated one (someone else's work that he reviewed) with its author and source. Each has a page with the details.

origin.description: Written by Mike, or reviewed by him

query.description: Keyword in the name, summary, outcome or author

tools.name: list_toolbox
tools.description: Find tools, methods and learning resources from the Architect's Toolbox Guide, filtered by architecture role, kind or keyword. Returns access and license notes and a link to each entry's details and sources.

query.description: Keyword in the name, publisher or summary
